question.text: Kamat Family Office Ltd., a body corporate, subscribes as LP in Himalaya Growth Fund. Under PMLA Rules, the AIF must identify Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs) of Kamat Family Office. The controlling ownership threshold for identifying a UBO of a COMPANY/TRUST is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Under PMLA Rules, the UBO threshold is 25% of ownership/entitlement for a company or trust, and 15% of ownership/entitlement for a partnership firm or unincorporated association of individuals. The Trap: Option A (10%) is unrelated to PMLA UBO. Option B (15%) is the threshold for partnerships and unincorporated associations — a swap trap. Option D (51%) is majority control, not UBO. Note: Workbook page 383 states the PMLA UBO thresholds of 25% for company/trust and 15% for partnership/unincorporated association.
